title: World Promotional Platform
tagline: Decentralized promotional platform built using World Coin for proof of personhood
description: Decentralized promotional platform where any individual or entity can promote any Crypto/Non Crypto projects example covid awareness, movie promotion and incentivize user for attending promotion by completing quiz. DApp solves sybil resistance using World id so that 1 person  has 1 account when claiming rewards.
how_its_made:
This project is build by using following: 
1. Solidity smart contract 
2. UI using react 
3. Chainlink Keepers to mark the promotion live as soon as the tokens are deposited into the contract. 
4. Integrated with WorldId for proof of personhood 
5. Contract is deployed on Polygon network
6. JSON files containing questionnaires are stored on IPFS
